Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly identified the source from the WebSurfer's search results, which stated Peter Schmeichel won "The World's Best Goalkeeper" from the IFFHS in 1992. However, in the "Updated Understanding" section of its second turn, the Planner hallucinated the awarding body, changing "IFFHS" to "FIFA" (stating "voted by FIFA as Goalkeeper of the Year"). This contradicted the evidence just retrieved and the known facts that the IFFHS is the organization that awards the "World's Best Goalkeeper" title, not FIFA (which has a different award). This error led to the incorrect final answer.
